string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: Updates are now found reliably: Able reads a small release file from the repository, which is not subject to GitHub\'s request limit and is never served stale.
If GitHub is unreachable, the check falls back to the GitHub API as before.
From 0.9.2: help pop-ups scroll, the double-tap time goes from 50 to 450 ms, and this window shows what changed after each update.
